I need to evaluate the claim that Sun Yat-sen overthrew the emperor in a country, establishing a republic after 2000 years of imperial rule.

- Sun Yat-sen was a key revolutionary leader in the 1911 Xinhai Revolution
- This revolution led to the overthrow of the Qing Dynasty in China
- The Republic of China was established in 1912
- Sun Yat-sen became the provisional president
- China had indeed experienced approximately 2000 years of imperial rule (from the Qin Dynasty in 221 BCE to 1912)
